limitations: Actual provider source/CLI success and final root-owned acceptance gates were not rerun in this read-only audit.

reviewed.cli: proof_contract_cli._parser adds the provider parser, contract_main dispatches expand-provider to expand_provider, and provider CLI loads three bounded JSON files then calls the public API with the selected app/occurrence and bounded limits. Root Path is supported by _proof_contract_planned_source_inputs._planned_input_size. Invalid CLI values are caught and emitted as bounded JSON; _exit_status maps unavailable/incomplete/rejected or unavailable slice to exit 2.
reviewed.initialDeadline: _expand takes min(outer,saved) then _initial_deadline tightens against declared native deadlineUtc before dispatching native validation. It only uses untrusted native bounds to shorten work; after validation the request is reconstructed and the actual planner deadline is reapplied. Three pure tests cover expired outer, saved, and declared-native clocks with a worker-fail spy.
reviewed.workerOutput: _response caps the serialized provider response and returns a small completed worker envelope whose nested result has status/code output-limit when the full body exceeds 8 MiB. Public _resource_stop recursively detects that nested stop, so the API returns incomplete instead of rejecting or publishing observation. The public result bound reserves one byte and preserves memory-report guidance.

verification.scope: Pure provider tests including CLI help/invalid input, deadline preflight, output fallback, binding tamper controls, fake-runner supervision. No Lean, extraction, or source-run worker.
